publication: David L. Poole and Alan K. Mackworth, Artificial Intelligence: Foundations of Computational Agents, third edition, 2023, author-hosted HTML, inspected 2026-10-23.

reviews.checked_passages: Sections 15.5.1–15.5.2: simultaneous substitutions, ground instances, finite Datalog bottom-up evaluation and its term-model completeness argument. The top-down procedure in 15.5.4 was not adopted.
reviews.outcome: No serious defect found in the adopted ground-instance and finite-base arguments. The corpus states the finite signature/program assumptions, treats function terms separately, and supplies the finite-body omega-stage proof.
